data.name: long_term_relations_protect_daily_choice_path
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER long_term_relations_protect_daily_choice_path
BEFORE UPDATE OF type, source_intention_id, related_intention_id
ON long_term_relations
WHEN
  (
    new.type <> old.type OR
    new.source_intention_id <> old.source_intention_id OR
    new.related_intention_id <> old.related_intention_id
  ) AND
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM daily_choice_path_steps
    WHERE long_term_relation_id = old.id
  )
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'long-term relation is used by a daily choice path');
END;

data.name: long_term_relations_active_participants_after_insert
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER long_term_relations_active_participants_after_insert
AFTER INSERT ON long_term_relations
WHEN
  new.is_archived = 0 AND
  (
    NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM intentions
      WHERE id = new.source_intention_id AND is_archived = 0
    ) OR
    NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM intentions
      WHERE id = new.related_intention_id AND is_archived = 0
    )
  )
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'active relation requires active intentions');
END;

CREATE TRIGGER long_term_relations_active_participants_after_update
AFTER UPDATE OF source_intention_id, related_intention_id, is_archived
ON long_term_relations
WHEN
  new.is_archived = 0 AND
  (
    NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM intentions
      WHERE id = new.source_intention_id AND is_archived = 0
    ) OR
    NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM intentions
      WHERE id = new.related_intention_id AND is_archived = 0
    )
  )
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'active relation requires active intentions');
END;

data.name: intentions_archive_requires_no_active_relations
data.sql:
CREATE TRIGGER intentions_archive_requires_no_active_relations
AFTER UPDATE OF is_archived ON intentions
WHEN
  old.is_archived = 0 AND
  new.is_archived = 1 AND
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM long_term_relations
    WHERE
      is_archived = 0 AND
      (
        source_intention_id = new.id OR
        related_intention_id = new.id
      )
  )
BEGIN
  SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'active relations must be archived first');
END;

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "intentions" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "title" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (title <> '' AND instr(CAST(title AS BLOB), X'00') = 0), "title_search_key" TEXT NOT NULL GENERATED ALWAYS AS (doable_title_search_key(title)) STORED CHECK (title_search_key <> '' AND instr(CAST(title_search_key AS BLOB), X'00') = 0), "description" TEXT CHECK (description IS NULL OR(instr(CAST(description AS BLOB), X'00') = 0 AND length(trim(description, char(9) || char(10) || char(11) || char(12) || char(13) || char(32))) > 0)), "is_action_ready" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE CHECK (is_action_ready IN (0, 1)), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE CHECK (is_archived IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_choices" ("creation_sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT CHECK (creation_sequence > 0), "id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "source_intention_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES intentions(id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "selected_intention_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES intentions(id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "choice_date" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(choice_date) = 'text' AND length(choice_date) = 10 AND choice_date GLOB '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]-[0-9][0-9]'), "description" TEXT CHECK (description IS NULL OR(typeof(description) = 'text' AND instr(CAST(description AS BLOB), X'00') = 0)), "is_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(is_completed) = 'integer' AND is_completed IN (0, 1)), CHECK(source_intention_id <> selected_intention_id));
CREATE INDEX daily_choices_date_creation_order ON daily_choices (choice_date, creation_sequence)
CREATE INDEX daily_choices_source_date_creation_order ON daily_choices (source_intention_id, choice_date, creation_sequence)
CREATE INDEX daily_choices_selected_date_creation_order ON daily_choices (selected_intention_id, choice_date, creation_sequence)
CREATE INDEX daily_choices_source_recent ON daily_choices (source_intention_id, creation_sequence DESC)
CREATE INDEX daily_choices_selected_recent ON daily_choices (selected_intention_id, creation_sequence DESC)

CREATE TRIGGER daily_choices_immutable_identity AFTER UPDATE OF creation_sequence, id ON daily_choices WHEN new.creation_sequence <> old.creation_sequence OR new.id <> old.id BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'daily choice identity is immutable');END

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "long_term_relations" ("creation_sequence" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT CHECK (creation_sequence > 0), "id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "source_intention_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES intentions(id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "related_intention_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES intentions(id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "type" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(type) = 'text' AND type IN ('need', 'can')), "priority" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (typeof(priority) = 'integer' AND priority BETWEEN 1 AND 4), "description" TEXT CHECK (description IS NULL OR(typeof(description) = 'text' AND instr(CAST(description AS BLOB), X'00') = 0)), "is_archived" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE CHECK (typeof(is_archived) = 'integer' AND is_archived IN (0, 1)), UNIQUE(source_intention_id, related_intention_id), CHECK(source_intention_id <> related_intention_id));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "daily_choice_path_steps" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, "daily_choice_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES daily_choices(id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE CASCADE, "long_term_relation_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES long_term_relations(id)ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT, "previous_step_id" TEXT, UNIQUE(daily_choice_id, id), FOREIGN KEY(daily_choice_id, previous_step_id)REFERENCES daily_choice_path_steps(daily_choice_id, id)ON UPDATE NO ACTION ON DELETE NO ACTION DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, CHECK(previous_step_id IS NULL OR previous_step_id <> id));
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX daily_choice_path_steps_one_root ON daily_choice_path_steps (daily_choice_id) WHERE previous_step_id IS NULL
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX daily_choice_path_steps_one_successor ON daily_choice_path_steps (daily_choice_id, previous_step_id) WHERE previous_step_id IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX daily_choice_path_steps_relation ON daily_choice_path_steps (long_term_relation_id)

CREATE TRIGGER long_term_relations_protect_daily_choice_path BEFORE UPDATE OF type, source_intention_id, related_intention_id ON long_term_relations WHEN(new.type <> old.type OR new.source_intention_id <> old.source_intention_id OR new.related_intention_id <> old.related_intention_id)AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM daily_choice_path_steps WHERE long_term_relation_id = old.id) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'long-term relation is used by a daily choice path');END
CREATE INDEX long_term_relations_source_group_order ON long_term_relations (source_intention_id, type, is_archived, priority, creation_sequence)
CREATE INDEX long_term_relations_related_group_order ON long_term_relations (related_intention_id, type, is_archived, priority, creation_sequence)

CREATE TRIGGER long_term_relations_immutable_identity AFTER UPDATE OF creation_sequence, id ON long_term_relations WHEN new.creation_sequence <> old.creation_sequence OR new.id <> old.id BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'long-term relation identity is immutable');END

CREATE TRIGGER long_term_relations_active_participants_after_insert AFTER INSERT ON long_term_relations WHEN new.is_archived = 0 AND(NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM intentions WHERE id = new.source_intention_id AND is_archived = 0) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM intentions WHERE id = new.related_intention_id AND is_archived = 0))BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'active relation requires active intentions');END

CREATE TRIGGER long_term_relations_active_participants_after_update AFTER UPDATE OF source_intention_id, related_intention_id, is_archived ON long_term_relations WHEN new.is_archived = 0 AND(NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM intentions WHERE id = new.source_intention_id AND is_archived = 0) OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM intentions WHERE id = new.related_intention_id AND is_archived = 0))BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'active relation requires active intentions');END

CREATE TRIGGER intentions_archive_requires_no_active_relations AFTER UPDATE OF is_archived ON intentions WHEN old.is_archived = 0 AND new.is_archived = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM long_term_relations WHERE is_archived = 0 AND(source_intention_id = new.id OR related_intention_id = new.id)) BEGIN SELECT RAISE (ABORT, 'active relations must be archived first');END
CREATE VIRTUAL TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "intention_titles_fts" USING fts5(title_search_key, content = 'intentions', content_rowid = 'rowid', tokenize = 'trigram case_sensitive 0 remove_diacritics 0');
CREATE TRIGGER intentions_fts_after_insert AFTER INSERT ON intentions BEGIN INSERT INTO intention_titles_fts ("rowid", title_search_key) VALUES (new."rowid", new.title_search_key);END

CREATE TRIGGER intentions_fts_after_update_search_content AFTER UPDATE ON intentions BEGIN INSERT INTO intention_titles_fts (intention_titles_fts, "rowid", title_search_key) VALUES ('delete', old."rowid", old.title_search_key);INSERT INTO intention_titles_fts ("rowid", title_search_key) VALUES (new."rowid", new.title_search_key);END

CREATE TRIGGER intentions_fts_after_delete AFTER DELETE ON intentions BEGIN INSERT INTO intention_titles_fts (intention_titles_fts, "rowid", title_search_key) VALUES ('delete', old."rowid", old.title_search_key);END
